title: DrawerForm, TabbedForm and WizardForm: editing a record that does not exist opens a blank editable form
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from #29157 (PR #29246; report `/mnt/project-files/issue-29157/os-dev-report.md`) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** A user who opens an old link to a deleted record in a drawer, tabbed or wizard form sees a blank form they can edit. They fill it in and press save, and only then learn the record does not exist. #29157 fixes this for the modal form (the `?form=` overlay) only. The other three form shells still do it.

**Measured (the #29157 dev, by reading at `dedc3505`; the modal case was probed live in tests).** `ObjectStackAdapter.readOne` answers `null` on a 404, and each shell turns that into an empty record:
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx:448`: `setFormData(data || {})`
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/TabbedForm.tsx:415`: `setFormData(data || {})`
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx:678-679`: `setFormData(data || {})`, which also sets `setPersistedRecord`

**Wanted.** In edit mode, a null read in each shell draws the same not-found state PR #29246 gives `ModalForm`: `Empty` with `empty.recordNotFound` and `empty.recordNotFoundDescription`, no form, no footer and no save. Reuse #29246's private `RecordNotFoundError` in `loadFailure.ts`. Create mode and a found record are unchanged. No new string.

**Tests.** For each shell, an edit whose `findOne` answers null renders the not-found state and no save control. Controls: create, and a found record. Each must be red on main.

**Reader.** `domain:ui` (`area:records`). Size S. Serialize after PR #29246 (#29157), which adds the shared failure marker.

Links back: #29157, PR #29246.
